title: Efficient Vulkan
description: A mod pack made for Vulkan, a more efficient graphics API than OpenGL; it also comes with popular resource packs, such as Recolourful Containers, Fresh Animations, 3D Default, and more.
body: This pack makes any PC's Minecraft framerate go into the hundreds or even thousands. Designed with a powerful new API compared to OpenGL, Vulkan will take your performance from 200 fps to almost 700 fps! It includes Many other optimization mods compatible with vulkan, such as but not limited to: Lithium, C2ME, ScalableLux, and others. One should download it if they are looking for a less laggy playthrough, a very vanilla-like game, and the most recent version of Minecraft: Java Edition, 26.1.2. It it designed with the least bloat possible. It includes only nessesary mods for optimization and does not add mods that take away the beauty of vanilla MC.
